          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Board.</span></h2>
          <p>"Board" means the Minnesota Board of Nursing.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.4a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4a.<span class="headnote">Certification.</span></h2>
          <p>"Certification" means the formal recognition of knowledge, skills, and experience demonstrated by the achievement of standards identified by the National Professional Nursing Organization acceptable to the Minnesota Board of Nursing.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.<span class="headnote">Clinical nurse specialist practice.</span></h2>
          <p>"Clinical nurse specialist practice" means:</p>
          <p>(1) the diagnosis and treatment of health and illness states;</p>
          <p>(2) disease management;</p>
          <p>(3) prescribing pharmacologic and nonpharmacologic therapies;</p>
          <p>(4) ordering, performing, supervising, and interpreting diagnostic studies, excluding interpreting computed tomography scans, magnetic resonance imaging scans, positron emission tomography scans, nuclear scans, and mammography;</p>
          <p>(5) prevention of illness and risk behaviors;</p>
          <p>(6) nursing care for individuals, families, and communities;</p>
          <p>(7) consulting with, collaborating with, or referring to other health care providers as warranted by the needs of the patient; and</p>
          <p>(8) integration of care across the continuum to improve patient outcomes.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.5a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5a.<span class="headnote">Collaboration.</span></h2>
          <p>"Collaboration" means the process in which two or more health care professionals work together to meet the health care needs of a patient, as warranted by the patient.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.6">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 6.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.42.0">2014 c 235 s 42</a>; 2014 c 312 art 24 s 43]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.7">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 7.<span class="headnote">Consultation.</span></h2>
          <p>"Consultation" means the process in which an advanced practice registered nurse who maintains primary management responsibility for a patient's care seeks advice or opinion of a physician or another member of the health care team.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.7a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 7a.<span class="headnote">Delegation.</span></h2>
          <p>"Delegation" means the transfer of authority to another nurse or competent, unlicensed assistive person to perform a specific nursing task or activity in a specific situation.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.7b">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 7b.<span class="headnote">Encumbered.</span></h2>
          <p>"Encumbered" means (1) a license that is revoked, suspended, or contains limitations on the full and unrestricted practice of nursing when the revocation, suspension, or limitation is imposed by a state licensing board, or (2) a license that is voluntarily surrendered.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.7c">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 7c.<span class="headnote">Intervention.</span></h2>
          <p>"Intervention" means any act or action based upon clinical judgment and knowledge that a nurse performs to enhance the health outcome of a patient.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.8">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 8.<span class="headnote">Licensed practical nurse.</span></h2>
          <p>"Licensed practical nurse," abbreviated LPN, means an individual licensed by the board to practice practical nursing.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.8a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 8a.<span class="headnote">Monitoring.</span></h2>
          <p>"Monitoring" means the periodic inspection by a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse of a delegated or assigned nursing task or activity and includes: (1) watching during the performance of the task or activity; (2) periodic checking and tracking of the progress of the task or activity being performed; (3) updating a supervisor on the progress or completion of the task or activity performed; and (4) contacting a supervisor as needed for direction and consultation.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.9">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 9.<span class="headnote">Nurse.</span></h2>
          <p>"Nurse" means advanced practice registered nurse, registered nurse, and licensed practical nurse unless the context clearly refers to only one category.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.10">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 10.<span class="headnote">Nurse-midwife practice.</span></h2>
          <p>"Nurse-midwife practice" means:</p>
          <p>(1) the management, diagnosis, and treatment of women's primary health care including pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum period, care of the newborn, family planning, partner care management relating to sexual health, and gynecological care of women across the life span;</p>
          <p>(2) ordering, performing, supervising, and interpreting diagnostic studies, excluding interpreting computed tomography scans, magnetic resonance imaging scans, positron emission tomography scans, nuclear scans, and mammography;</p>
          <p>(3) prescribing pharmacologic and nonpharmacologic therapies; and</p>
          <p>(4) consulting with, collaborating with, or referring to other health care providers as warranted by the needs of the patient.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.11">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 11.<span class="headnote">Nurse practitioner practice.</span></h2>
          <p>"Nurse practitioner practice" means the provision of care including:</p>
          <p>(1) health promotion, disease prevention, health education, and counseling;</p>
          <p>(2) providing health assessment and screening activities;</p>
          <p>(3) diagnosing, treating, and facilitating patients' management of their acute and chronic illnesses and diseases;</p>
          <p>(4) ordering, performing, supervising, and interpreting diagnostic studies, excluding interpreting computed tomography scans, magnetic resonance imaging scans, positron emission tomography scans, nuclear scans, and mammography;</p>
          <p>(5) prescribing pharmacologic and nonpharmacologic therapies; and</p>
          <p>(6) consulting with, collaborating with, or referring to other health care providers as warranted by the needs of the patient.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.12">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 12.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2013/0/31/#laws.0.11.0">2013 c 31 s 11</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.12a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 12a.<span class="headnote">Patient.</span></h2>
          <p>"Patient" means a recipient of nursing care, including an individual, family, group, or community.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.12b">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 12b.<span class="headnote">Population focus.</span></h2>
          <p>"Population focus" means the categories of patients for which the advanced practice registered nurse has the educational preparation to provide care and services. The categories of population foci are:</p>
          <p>(1) family and individual across the life span;</p>
          <p>(2) adult gerontology;</p>
          <p>(3) neonatal;</p>
          <p>(4) pediatrics;</p>
          <p>(5) women's and gender-related health; and</p>
          <p>(6) psychiatric and mental health.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.13">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 13.<span class="headnote">Practice of advanced practice registered nursing.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) The "practice of advanced practice registered nursing" means the performance of an expanded scope of nursing in at least one of the recognized advanced practice registered nurse roles for at least one population focus. The scope and practice standards of an advanced practice registered nurse are defined by the national professional nursing organizations specific to the practice as a clinical nurse specialist, nurse-midwife, nurse practitioner, or registered nurse anesthetist in the population focus. The scope of advanced practice registered nursing includes, but is not limited to, performing acts of advanced assessment, diagnosing, prescribing, and ordering. The practice includes functioning as a primary care provider, direct care provider, case manager, consultant, educator, and researcher.</p>
          <p>(b) The practice of advanced practice registered nursing requires the advanced practice registered nurse to be accountable: (1) to patients for the quality of advanced nursing care rendered; (2) for recognizing limits of knowledge and experience; and (3) for planning for the management of situations beyond the advanced practice registered nurse's expertise. The practice of advanced practice registered nursing includes accepting referrals from, consulting with, collaborating with, or referring to other health care providers as warranted by the needs of the patient.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.14">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 14.<span class="headnote">Practice of practical nursing.</span></h2>
          <p>The "practice of practical nursing" means the performance, with or without compensation, of those services that incorporates caring for individual patients in all settings through nursing standards recognized by the board at the direction of a registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or other licensed health care provider and includes, but is not limited to:</p>
          <p>(1) conducting a focused assessment of the health status of an individual patient through the collection and comparison of data to normal findings and the individual patient's current health status, and reporting changes and responses to interventions in an ongoing manner to a registered nurse or the appropriate licensed health care provider for delegated or assigned tasks or activities;</p>
          <p>(2) participating with other health care providers in the development and modification of a plan of care;</p>
          <p>(3) determining and implementing appropriate interventions within a nursing plan of care or when delegated or assigned by a registered nurse;</p>
          <p>(4) implementing interventions that are delegated, ordered, or prescribed by a licensed health care provider;</p>
          <p>(5) assigning nursing activities or tasks to other licensed practical nurses (LPNs);</p>
          <p>(6) assigning and monitoring nursing tasks or activities to unlicensed assistive personnel;</p>
          <p>(7) providing safe and effective nursing care delivery;</p>
          <p>(8) promoting a safe and therapeutic environment;</p>
          <p>(9) advocating for the best interests of individual patients;</p>
          <p>(10) assisting in the evaluation of responses to interventions;</p>
          <p>(11) collaborating and communicating with other health care providers;</p>
          <p>(12) providing health care information to individual patients;</p>
          <p>(13) providing input into the development of policies and procedures; and</p>
          <p>(14) accountability for the quality of care delivered, recognizing the limits of knowledge and experience; addressing situations beyond the nurse's competency; and performing to the level of education, knowledge, and skill ordinarily expected of an individual who has completed an approved practical nursing education program described in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.211#stat.148.211.1">148.211, subdivision 1</a>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.15">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 15.<span class="headnote">Practice of professional nursing.</span></h2>
          <p>The "practice of professional nursing" means the performance, with or without compensation, of those services that incorporates caring for all patients in all settings through nursing standards recognized by the board and includes, but is not limited to:</p>
          <p>(1) providing a comprehensive assessment of the health status of a patient through the collection, analysis, and synthesis of data used to establish a health status baseline and plan of care, and address changes in a patient's condition;</p>
          <p>(2) collaborating with the health care team to develop and coordinate an integrated plan of care;</p>
          <p>(3) developing nursing interventions to be integrated with the plan of care;</p>
          <p>(4) implementing nursing care through the execution of independent nursing interventions;</p>
          <p>(5) implementing interventions that are delegated, ordered, or prescribed by a licensed health care provider;</p>
          <p>(6) delegating nursing tasks or assigning nursing activities to implement the plan of care;</p>
          <p>(7) providing safe and effective nursing care;</p>
          <p>(8) promoting a safe and therapeutic environment;</p>
          <p>(9) advocating for the best interests of individual patients;</p>
          <p>(10) evaluating responses to interventions and the effectiveness of the plan of care;</p>
          <p>(11) collaborating and coordinating with other health care professionals in the management and implementation of care within and across care settings and communities;</p>
          <p>(12) providing health promotion, disease prevention, care coordination, and case finding;</p>
          <p class="in">(13) designing and implementing teaching plans based on patient need, and evaluating their effectiveness;</p>
          <p>(14) participating in the development of health care policies, procedures, and systems;</p>
          <p>(15) managing, supervising, and evaluating the practice of nursing;</p>
          <p>(16) teaching the theory and practice of nursing; and</p>
          <p>(17) accountability for the quality of care delivered, recognizing the limits of knowledge and experience; addressing situations beyond the nurse's competency; and performing to the level of education, knowledge, and skill ordinarily expected of an individual who has completed an approved professional nursing education program as described in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.211#stat.148.211.1">148.211, subdivision 1</a>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.16">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 16.<span class="headnote">Prescribing.</span></h2>
          <p>"Prescribing" means the act of generating a prescription for the preparation of, use of, or manner of using a drug or therapeutic device in accordance with the provisions of section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.235">148.235</a>. Prescribing does not include recommending the use of a drug or therapeutic device which is not required by the federal Food and Drug Administration to meet the labeling requirements for prescription drugs and devices. Prescribing also does not include recommending or administering a drug or therapeutic device for anesthesia care by a certified registered nurse anesthetist.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.17">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 17.<span class="headnote">Prescription.</span></h2>
          <p>"Prescription" means a written direction or an oral direction reduced to writing provided to or for an individual patient for the preparation or use of a drug or therapeutic device. In the case of a prescription for a drug, the requirements of section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/151.01">151.01, subdivisions 16</a>, 16a, and 16b, shall apply.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.17a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 17a.<span class="headnote">Primary care provider.</span></h2>
          <p>"Primary care provider" means a licensed health care provider who acts as the first point of care for comprehensive health maintenance and promotion, preventive care, and undiagnosed health concerns and who provides continuing care of varied health conditions not limited by cause, organ systems, or diagnosis.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.18">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 18.<span class="headnote">Public health nurse.</span></h2>
          <p>"Public health nurse" means a registered nurse who meets the voluntary registration requirements established by the board by rule.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.19">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 19.<span class="headnote">Referral.</span></h2>
          <p>"Referral" means the process in which an advanced practice registered nurse directs a patient to a physician or another health care professional for management of a particular problem or aspect of the patient's care.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.20">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 20.<span class="headnote">Registered nurse.</span></h2>
          <p>"Registered nurse," abbreviated RN, means an individual licensed by the board to practice professional nursing.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.21">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 21.<span class="headnote">Registered nurse anesthetist practice.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) "Registered nurse anesthetist practice" means the provision of anesthesia care and related services including:</p>
          <p>(1) selecting, obtaining, and administering drugs and therapeutic devices to facilitate diagnostic, therapeutic, and surgical procedures;</p>
          <p>(2) ordering, performing, supervising, and interpreting diagnostic studies, excluding interpreting computed tomography scans, magnetic resonance imaging scans, positron emission tomography scans, nuclear scans, and mammography;</p>
          <p>(3) prescribing pharmacologic and nonpharmacologic therapies; and</p>
          <p>(4) consulting with, collaborating with, or referring to other health care providers as warranted by the needs of the patient.</p>
          <p>(b) A registered nurse anesthetist may perform nonsurgical therapies for acute and chronic pain symptoms upon referral and in collaboration with a physician licensed under chapter 147. For purposes of providing nonsurgical therapies for acute and chronic pain symptoms, the registered nurse anesthetist and one or more physicians licensed under chapter 147 must have a mutually agreed upon plan that designates the scope of collaboration necessary for providing nonsurgical therapies to patients with acute and chronic pain. The registered nurse anesthetist must perform the nonsurgical therapies at the same licensed health care facility as the physician.</p>
          <p>(c) Notwithstanding section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.235">148.235</a>, for purposes of providing nonsurgical pain therapies for chronic pain symptoms, the registered nurse anesthetist must have a written prescribing agreement with a physician licensed under chapter 147 that defines the delegated responsibilities related to prescribing drugs and therapeutic devices within the scope of the agreement and the practice of the registered nurse anesthetist.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.22">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 22.<span class="headnote">Registered nurse, certified.</span></h2>
          <p>"Registered nurse, certified," abbreviated RN,C, means a registered nurse who has received certification from a national nursing organization or national nurse certification organization for practice according to subdivision 15 in a specialized field of professional nursing. A registered nurse, certified, shall not practice advanced practice registered nursing as described in subdivision 5, 10, 11, 13, or 21.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.22a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 22a.<span class="headnote">Roles of advanced practice registered nurses.</span></h2>
          <p>"Role" means one of four recognized advanced practice registered nurse roles: certified registered nurse anesthetist (CRNA); certified nurse-midwife (CNM); certified clinical nurse specialist (CNS); or certified nurse practitioner (CNP).</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.23">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 23.<span class="headnote">Supervision.</span></h2>
          <p>"Supervision" means the guidance by a registered nurse in the accomplishment of a nursing task or activity. Supervision consists of monitoring, as well as establishing, the initial direction, delegating, setting expectations, directing activities and courses of action, evaluating, and changing a course of action.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.171.24">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 24.<span class="headnote">Unlicensed assistive personnel.</span></h2>
          <p>"Unlicensed assistive personnel" (UAP) means any unlicensed person to whom nursing tasks or activities may be delegated or assigned, as approved by the board.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.171.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.1.0">1945 c 242 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1955/0/34/#laws.0.1.0">1955 c 34 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1959/0/140/#laws.0.1.0">1959 c 140 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1974/0/554/#laws.0.1.0">1974 c 554 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1988/0/440/#laws.0.1.0">1988 c 440 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1989/0/194/#laws.0.3.0">1989 c 194 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1990/0/483/#laws.0.1.0">1990 c 483 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/172/#laws.0.2.0">1999 c 172 s 2</a>,18; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2013/0/31/#laws.0.1.0">2013 c 31 s 1</a>-9; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.1.0">2014 c 235 s 1</a>-14; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2017/0/57/#laws.0.1.0">2017 c 57 s 1</a>,2</p>
      </div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.18"><b>148.18</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.14.0">1945 c 242 s 14</a>]</div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.181">
        <h1 class="shn">148.181 BOARD OF NURSING MEMBERSHIP, VACANCIES, DISCLOSURE.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.181.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Membership.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) The Board of Nursing consists of 16 members appointed by the governor, each of whom must be a resident of this state. Eight members must be registered nurses, each of whom must have graduated from an approved school of nursing, must be licensed and currently registered as a registered nurse in this state, and must have had at least five years experience in nursing practice, nursing administration, or nursing education immediately preceding appointment. One of the eight must have had at least two years executive or teaching experience in a baccalaureate degree nursing program approved by the board under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.251">148.251</a> during the five years immediately preceding appointment, one of the eight must have had at least two years executive or teaching experience in an associate degree nursing program approved by the board under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.251">148.251</a> during the five years immediately preceding appointment, one of the eight must be practicing professional nursing in a nursing home at the time of appointment, one of the eight must have had at least two years executive or teaching experience in a practical nursing program approved by the board under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.251">148.251</a> during the five years immediately preceding appointment, and one of the eight must be licensed and have national certification or recertification as a registered nurse anesthetist, nurse practitioner, nurse midwife, or clinical nurse specialist. Four of the eight must have had at least five years of experience in nursing practice or nursing administration immediately preceding appointment. Four members must be licensed practical nurses, each of whom must have graduated from an approved school of nursing, must be licensed and currently registered as a licensed practical nurse in this state, and must have had at least five years experience in nursing practice immediately preceding appointment. The remaining four members must be public members as defined by section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/214.02">214.02</a>.</p>
          <p>(b) A member may be reappointed but may not serve more than two full terms consecutively. The governor shall attempt to make appointments to the board that reflect the geography of the state. The board members who are nurses should as a whole reflect the broad mix of practice types and sites of nurses practicing in Minnesota.</p>
          <p>(c) Membership terms, compensation of members, removal of members, the filling of membership vacancies, and fiscal year and reporting requirements are as provided in sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/214.07">214.07</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/214.09">214.09</a>. Any nurse on the board who during incumbency permanently ceases to be actively engaged in the practice of nursing or otherwise becomes disqualified for board membership is automatically removed, and the governor shall fill the vacancy. The provision of staff, administrative services, and office space; the review and processing of complaints; the setting of board fees; and other provisions relating to board operations are as provided in sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.171">148.171</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.285">148.285</a> and chapter 214. Each member of the board shall file with the secretary of state the constitutional oath of office before beginning the term of office.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.181.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Vacancies.</span></h2>
          <p>On expiration of the term of a member who is a registered nurse, the governor may appoint a registered nurse from a list of members submitted by professional nursing groups. Likewise on expiration of the term of a member who is a licensed practical nurse, the governor may appoint a licensed practical nurse from a list of members submitted by licensed practical nursing groups. These lists should contain names of persons in number at least twice the number of places to be filled. Vacancies occurring on the board, when the member is a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse, may be filled for the unexpired terms by appointments to be made by the governor from nominations submitted by nursing groups in the manner aforesaid or from other recommendations. Members shall hold office until a successor is appointed and qualified.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.181.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.</h2>
          <p>MS 1974 [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1975/0/136/#laws.0.77.0">1975 c 136 s 77</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.181.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Disclosure.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) A disciplinary hearing must be closed to the public.</p>
          <p>(b) Upon application of a party in a proceeding before the board under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.261">148.261</a>, the board shall produce and permit the inspection and copying, by or on behalf of the moving party, of any designated documents or papers relevant to the proceedings, in accordance with <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/court_rules/cp/id/34/">rule 34</a> of the Minnesota Rules of Civil Procedure.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.181.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.2.0">1945 c 242 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1955/0/34/#laws.0.2.0">1955 c 34 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1971/0/418/#laws.0.1.0">1971 c 418 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1973/0/638/#laws.0.14.0">1973 c 638 s 14</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1975/0/136/#laws.0.10.0">1975 c 136 s 10</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1975/0/360/#laws.0.1.0">1975 c 360 s 1</a>,2; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1976/0/222/#laws.0.50.0">1976 c 222 s 50</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1976/0/239/#laws.0.55.0">1976 c 239 s 55</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1981/0/94/#laws.0.1.0">1981 c 94 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1986/0/444/#laws.0.0.0">1986 c 444</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1989/0/194/#laws.0.4.0">1989 c 194 s 4</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/88/#laws.0.1.0">1993 c 88 s 1</a>,2; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/105/#laws.0.1.0">1993 c 105 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/366/#laws.0.1.0">1993 c 366 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.15.0">2014 c 235 s 15</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.19"><b>148.19</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.14.0">1945 c 242 s 14</a>]</div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.191">
        <h1 class="shn">148.191 OFFICERS; STAFF; POWERS.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.191.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Officers; staff.</span></h2>
          <p>The board shall elect from its members a president, a vice-president, and a secretary-treasurer who shall each serve for one year or until a successor is elected and qualifies. The board shall appoint and employ an executive director subject to the terms described in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/214.04#stat.214.04.2a">214.04, subdivision 2a</a>, and may employ such persons as may be necessary to carry on its work. A majority of the board, including one officer, shall constitute a quorum at any meeting.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.191.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Powers.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) The board is authorized to adopt and, from time to time, revise rules not inconsistent with the law, as may be necessary to enable it to carry into effect the provisions of sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.171">148.171</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.285">148.285</a>. The board shall prescribe by rule curricula and standards for schools and courses preparing persons for licensure under sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.171">148.171 </a>to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.285">148.285</a>. It shall conduct or provide for surveys of such schools and courses at such times as it may deem necessary. It shall approve such schools and courses as meet the requirements of sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.171">148.171</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.285">148.285</a> and board rules. It shall examine, license, and renew the license of duly qualified applicants. It shall hold examinations at least once in each year at such time and place as it may determine. It shall by rule adopt, evaluate, and periodically revise, as necessary, requirements for licensure and for registration and renewal of registration as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.231">148.231</a>. It shall maintain a record of all persons licensed by the board to practice advanced practice, professional, or practical nursing. It shall cause the prosecution of all persons violating sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.171">148.171</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.285">148.285</a> and have power to incur such necessary expense therefor. It shall register public health nurses who meet educational and other requirements established by the board by rule, including payment of a fee. It shall have power to issue subpoenas, and to compel the attendance of witnesses and the production of all necessary documents and other evidentiary material. Any board member may administer oaths to witnesses, or take their affirmation. It shall keep a record of all its proceedings.</p>
          <p>(b) The board shall have access to hospital, nursing home, and other medical records of a patient cared for by a nurse under review. If the board does not have a written consent from a patient permitting access to the patient's records, the nurse or facility shall delete any data in the record that identifies the patient before providing it to the board. The board shall have access to such other records as reasonably requested by the board to assist the board in its investigation. Nothing herein may be construed to allow access to any records protected by section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/145.64">145.64</a>. The board shall maintain any records obtained pursuant to this paragraph as investigative data under chapter 13.</p>
          <p>(c) The board may accept and expend grants or gifts of money or in-kind services from a person, a public or private entity, or any other source for purposes consistent with the board's role and within the scope of its statutory authority.</p>
          <p>(d) The board may accept registration fees for meetings and conferences conducted for the purposes of board activities that are within the scope of its authority.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.191.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1989/0/194/#laws.0.22.0">1989 c 194 s 22</a>]</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.191.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.3.0">1945 c 242 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1955/0/847/#laws.0.13.0">1955 c 847 s 13</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1975/0/136/#laws.0.12.0">1975 c 136 s 12</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1975/0/240/#laws.0.1.0">1975 c 240 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1975/0/360/#laws.0.3.0">1975 c 360 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1976/0/222/#laws.0.51.0">1976 c 222 s 51</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1983/0/260/#laws.0.36.0">1983 c 260 s 36</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1986/0/444/#laws.0.0.0">1986 c 444</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1989/0/194/#laws.0.5.0">1989 c 194 s 5</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/172/#laws.0.3.0">1999 c 172 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2004/0/279/#laws.11.3.0">2004 c 279 art 11 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2011/1/9/#laws.5.3.0">1Sp2011 c 9 art 5 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.16.0">2014 c 235 s 16</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.20"><b>148.20</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.14.0">1945 c 242 s 14</a>]</div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.201"><b>148.201</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1975/0/136/#laws.0.77.0">1975 c 136 s 77</a>]</div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.21"><b>148.21</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.14.0">1945 c 242 s 14</a>]</div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.211">
        <h1 class="shn">148.211 LICENSING.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.211.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Licensure by examination.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) An applicant for a license to practice as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse shall apply to the board for a license by examination on forms prescribed by the board and pay a fee in an amount determined by statute. An applicant applying for reexamination shall pay a fee in an amount determined by law. In no case may fees be refunded.</p>
          <p>(b) The applicant must satisfy the following requirements for licensure by examination:</p>
          <p>(1) present evidence the applicant has not engaged in conduct warranting disciplinary action under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.261">148.261</a>;</p>
          <p>(2) present evidence of completion of a nursing education program approved by the board, another United States nursing board, or a Canadian province, which prepared the applicant for the type of license for which the application has been submitted; and</p>
          <p>(3) pass a national nurse licensure written examination. "Written examination" includes paper and pencil examinations and examinations administered with a computer and related technology and may include supplemental oral or practical examinations approved by the board.</p>
          <p>(c) An applicant who graduated from an approved nursing education program in Canada and was licensed in Canada or another United States jurisdiction, without passing the national nurse licensure examination, must also submit a verification of licensure from the original Canadian licensure authority and from the United States jurisdiction.</p>
          <p>(d) An applicant who graduated from a nursing program in a country other than the United States or Canada must also satisfy the following requirements:</p>
          <p>(1) present verification of graduation from a nursing education program which prepared the applicant for the type of license for which the application has been submitted and is determined to be equivalent to the education required in the same type of nursing education programs in the United States as evaluated by a credentials evaluation service acceptable to the board. The credentials evaluation service must submit the evaluation and verification directly to the board;</p>
          <p>(2) demonstrate successful completion of coursework to resolve identified nursing education deficiencies; and</p>
          <p>(3) pass examinations acceptable to the board that test written and spoken English, unless the applicant graduated from a nursing education program conducted in English and located in an English-speaking country. The results of the examinations must be submitted directly to the board from the testing service.</p>
          <p>(e) An applicant failing to pass the examination may apply for reexamination.</p>
          <p>(f) When the applicant has met all requirements stated in this subdivision, the board shall issue a license to the applicant. The board may issue a license with conditions and limitations if it considers it necessary to protect the public.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.211.1a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 1a.<span class="headnote">Advanced practice registered nurse licensure.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) No advanced practice registered nurse shall practice as an advanced practice registered nurse unless the advanced practice registered nurse is licensed by the board under this section.</p>
          <p>(b) An applicant for a license to practice as an advanced practice registered nurse (APRN) shall apply to the board in a format prescribed by the board and pay a fee in an amount determined under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.243">148.243</a>.</p>
          <p>(c) To be eligible for licensure an applicant:</p>
          <p>(1) must hold a current Minnesota professional nursing license or demonstrate eligibility for licensure as a registered nurse in this state;</p>
          <p>(2) must not hold an encumbered license as a registered nurse in any state or territory;</p>
          <p>(3)(i) must have completed a graduate level APRN program accredited by a nursing or nursing-related accrediting body that is recognized by the United States Secretary of Education or the Council for Higher Education Accreditation as acceptable to the board. The education must be in one of the four APRN roles for at least one population focus. For APRN programs completed on or after January 1, 2016, the program must include at least one graduate-level course in each of the following areas: advanced physiology and pathophysiology; advanced health assessment; and pharmacokinetics and pharmacotherapeutics of all broad categories of agents; or</p>
          <p>(ii) must demonstrate compliance with the advanced practice registered nursing educational requirements that were in effect in Minnesota at the time the applicant completed the advanced practice registered nursing education program;</p>
          <p>(4) must be currently certified by a national certifying body recognized by the board in the APRN role and population foci appropriate to educational preparation;</p>
          <p>(5) must report any criminal conviction, nolo contendere plea, Alford plea, or other plea arrangement in lieu of conviction; and</p>
          <p>(6) must not have committed any acts or omissions which are grounds for disciplinary action in another jurisdiction or, if these acts have been committed and would be grounds for disciplinary action as set forth in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.261">148.261</a>, the board has found, after investigation, that sufficient restitution has been made.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.211.1b">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 1b.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2017/0/57/#laws.0.6.0">2017 c 57 s 6</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.211.1c">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 1c.<span class="headnote">Postgraduate practice.</span></h2>
          <p>A nurse practitioner or clinical nurse specialist who qualifies for licensure as an advanced practice registered nurse must practice for at least 2,080 hours, within the context of a collaborative agreement, within a hospital or integrated clinical setting where advanced practice registered nurses and physicians work together to provide patient care. The nurse practitioner or clinical nurse specialist shall submit written evidence to the board with the application, or upon completion of the required collaborative practice experience. For purposes of this subdivision, a collaborative agreement is a mutually agreed upon plan for the overall working relationship between a nurse practitioner or clinical nurse specialist, and one or more physicians licensed under chapter 147 or in another state or United States territory, or one or more advanced practice registered nurses licensed under this section that designates the scope of collaboration necessary to manage the care of patients. The nurse practitioner or clinical nurse specialist, and one of the collaborating physicians or advanced practice registered nurses, must have experience in providing care to patients with the same or similar medical problems.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.211.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Licensure by endorsement.</span></h2>
          <p> The board shall issue a license to practice professional nursing or practical nursing without examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed or registered as a nurse under the laws of another state, territory, or country, if in the opinion of the board the applicant has the qualifications equivalent to the qualifications required in this state as stated in subdivision 1, all other laws not inconsistent with this section, and rules promulgated by the board.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.211.2a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2a.<span class="headnote">License recognition for nurses from border states; reciprocity.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) A license to practice professional or practical nursing issued by Iowa, North Dakota, South Dakota, or Wisconsin (border state) to a resident in that state must be recognized by the board as authorizing a licensure privilege to practice professional or practical nursing in Minnesota, if:</p>
          <p>(1) the licensure standards in the state licensed are substantially the same as Minnesota licensure standards;</p>
          <p>(2) the border state has not taken adverse action against the nurse license;</p>
          <p>(3) the nurse is not participating in an alternative or diversion program; or</p>
          <p>(4) the nurse has not been refused a license to practice nursing in Minnesota.</p>
          <p>(b) Within ten days of employment by a hospital, clinic, prepaid medical plan, or other health care institution or organization located in this state, a nurse who practices professional or practical nursing in Minnesota under the authority of a licensure privilege as provided in this subdivision shall report the employment to the board on a form provided by the board. The board shall maintain a list of the nurses practicing in Minnesota under this subdivision.</p>
          <p>(c) A nurse who practices professional or practical nursing in Minnesota under the authority of a licensure privilege as provided in this subdivision has the same obligations as if the nurse was licensed in Minnesota and is subject to the laws and rules of Minnesota and the regulatory authority of the board, including taking all forms of disciplinary action provided for in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.262#stat.148.262.1">148.262, subdivision 1</a>, and corrective action provided for in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/214.103#stat.214.103.6">214.103, subdivision 6</a>, against an individual's licensure privilege based on the grounds listed in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.261#stat.148.261.1">148.261, subdivision 1</a>, any other statute authorizing or requiring the board to take corrective or disciplinary action, and issuing a cease and desist order to limit or revoke a nurse's authority to practice in Minnesota. The board is authorized to recover from a nurse practicing professional or practical nursing in Minnesota under this subdivision the cost of proceedings as provided in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.262#stat.148.262.4">148.262, subdivision 4</a>. The board shall promptly report any such actions to the border state licensing board.</p>
          <p>(d) The board shall seek reciprocity of nurse licensure with Iowa, North Dakota, South Dakota, and Wisconsin. Lack of reciprocity does not limit the board's recognition of nurse licenses from border states.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.211.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1976/0/222/#laws.0.209.0">1976 c 222 s 209</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.211.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Education waived.</span></h2>
          <p>A person who has been licensed as a licensed practical nurse in another state, who has passed a licensing examination acceptable to the board, and who has had 24 months of experience as a licensed practical nurse in the five years prior to applying for a license is not required to meet any additional educational requirements.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.211.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.<span class="headnote">Denial of license.</span></h2>
          <p>Refusal of an applicant to supply information necessary to determine the applicant's qualifications, failure to demonstrate qualifications, or failure to satisfy the requirements for a license contained in this section or rules of the board may result in denial of a license. The burden of proof is upon the applicant to demonstrate the qualifications and satisfaction of the requirements.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.211.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.5.0">1945 c 242 s 5</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1955/0/34/#laws.0.4.0">1955 c 34 s 4</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1961/0/56/#laws.0.1.0">1961 c 56 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1967/0/68/#laws.0.1.0">1967 c 68 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1969/0/53/#laws.0.1.0">1969 c 53 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1975/0/360/#laws.0.4.0">1975 c 360 s 4</a>,5; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1976/0/222/#laws.0.52.0">1976 c 222 s 52</a>,53; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1981/0/94/#laws.0.2.0">1981 c 94 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1986/0/444/#laws.0.0.0">1986 c 444</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1989/0/194/#laws.0.6.0">1989 c 194 s 6</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/88/#laws.0.3.0">1993 c 88 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2002/0/272/#laws.0.1.0">2002 c 272 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2004/0/279/#laws.4.1.0">2004 c 279 art 4 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.17.0">2014 c 235 s 17</a>-20; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2017/0/57/#laws.0.3.0">2017 c 57 s 3</a>-5; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2023/0/25/#laws.0.51.0">2023 c 25 s 51</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.212">
        <h1 class="shn">148.212 TEMPORARY PERMIT.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.212.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Issuance.</span></h2>
          <p>Upon receipt of the applicable licensure or reregistration fee and permit fee, and in accordance with rules of the board, the board may issue a nonrenewable temporary permit to practice professional or practical nursing to an applicant for licensure or reregistration who is not the subject of a pending investigation or disciplinary action, nor disqualified for any other reason, under the following circumstances:</p>
          <p>(a) The applicant for licensure by endorsement under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.211#stat.148.211.2">148.211, subdivision 2</a>, is currently licensed to practice professional or practical nursing in another state, territory, or Canadian province. The permit is valid until the date of board action on the application or for 60 days, whichever comes first.</p>
          <p>(b) The applicant for licensure by endorsement under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.211#stat.148.211.2">148.211, subdivision 2</a>, or for reregistration under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.231#stat.148.231.5">148.231, subdivision 5</a>, is currently registered in a formal, structured refresher course or its equivalent for nurses that includes clinical practice.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.212.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Revocation.</span></h2>
          <p>The board may revoke a temporary permit that has been issued to an applicant for licensure under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.211">148.211</a>, subdivisions 1 and 2, if the applicant is the subject of an investigation or disciplinary action, or is disqualified for any other reason.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.212.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Release of information.</span></h2>
          <p>Notwithstanding section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/13.41#stat.13.41.2">13.41, subdivision 2</a>, the board may release information regarding action taken by the board pursuant to subdivisions 1 and 2.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.212.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1989/0/194/#laws.0.7.0">1989 c 194 s 7</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/88/#laws.0.4.0">1993 c 88 s 4</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2001/1/9/#laws.13.2.0">1Sp2001 c 9 art 13 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2002/0/379/#laws.1.113.0">2002 c 379 art 1 s 113</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2003/0/87/#laws.0.4.0">2003 c 87 s 4</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2004/0/279/#laws.4.2.0">2004 c 279 art 4 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2011/1/9/#laws.5.4.0">1Sp2011 c 9 art 5 s 4</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.22"><b>148.22</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.14.0">1945 c 242 s 14</a>]</div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.221"><b>148.221</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1989/0/194/#laws.0.22.0">1989 c 194 s 22</a>]</div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.23"><b>148.23</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.14.0">1945 c 242 s 14</a>]</div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.231">
        <h1 class="shn">148.231 REGISTRATION; FAILURE TO REGISTER; REREGISTRATION; VERIFICATION.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.231.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Registration.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) Every person licensed to practice advanced practice, professional, or practical nursing must maintain with the board a current registration for practice as an advanced practice registered nurse, registered nurse, or licensed practical nurse which must be renewed at regular intervals established by the board by rule. No registration shall be issued by the board to a nurse until the nurse has submitted satisfactory evidence of compliance with the procedures and minimum requirements established by the board.</p>
          <p>(b) Upon receipt of the application and the required fees, as determined under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.243">148.243</a>, the board shall verify the application and the evidence of completion of continuing education requirements in effect, and issue to the nurse registration for the next renewal period.</p>
          <p>(c) An applicant for advanced practice registered nursing (APRN) renewal must provide evidence of current certification or recertification in the appropriate APRN role in at least one population focus by a nationally accredited certifying body recognized by the board.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.231.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1981/0/94/#laws.0.12.0">1981 c 94 s 12</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.231.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1976/0/222/#laws.0.209.0">1976 c 222 s 209</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.231.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Failure to register.</span></h2>
          <p>Any person licensed under the provisions of sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.171">148.171</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.285">148.285</a> who fails to register within the required period shall not be entitled to practice nursing in this state as an advanced practice registered nurse, a registered nurse, or a licensed practical nurse.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.231.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.<span class="headnote">Reregistration.</span></h2>
          <p>A person whose registration has lapsed desiring to resume practice shall make application for reregistration, submit satisfactory evidence of compliance with the procedures and requirements established by the board, and pay the reregistration fee for the current period to the board. A penalty fee shall be required from a person who practiced nursing without current registration. Thereupon, registration shall be issued to the person who shall immediately be placed on the practicing list as an advanced practice registered nurse, a registered nurse, or a licensed practical nurse.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.231.6">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 6.<span class="headnote">Verification.</span></h2>
          <p>A person licensed under the provisions of sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.171">148.171</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.285">148.285</a> who requests the board to verify a Minnesota license to another state, territory, or country or to an agency, facility, school, or institution shall pay a fee for each verification.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.231.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.7.0">1945 c 242 s 7</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1947/0/286/#laws.0.1.0">1947 c 286 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1955/0/34/#laws.0.5.0">1955 c 34 s 5</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1961/0/8/#laws.0.2.0">1961 c 8 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1967/0/68/#laws.0.2.0">1967 c 68 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1969/0/53/#laws.0.2.0">1969 c 53 s 2</a>,3; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1971/0/131/#laws.0.1.0">1971 c 131 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1975/0/240/#laws.0.2.0">1975 c 240 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1975/0/360/#laws.0.6.0">1975 c 360 s 6</a>,7; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1976/0/149/#laws.0.30.0">1976 c 149 s 30</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1981/0/94/#laws.0.3.0">1981 c 94 s 3</a>-6; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1986/0/444/#laws.0.0.0">1986 c 444</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1989/0/194/#laws.0.8.0">1989 c 194 s 8</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1996/0/318/#laws.0.1.0">1996 c 318 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2011/1/9/#laws.5.5.0">1Sp2011 c 9 art 5 s 5</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.21.0">2014 c 235 s 21</a>-23</p>
      </div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.232"><b>148.232</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2016/0/158/#laws.1.215.0">2016 c 158 art 1 s 215</a>]</div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.233">
        <h1 class="shn">148.233 IDENTIFICATION OF CERTIFIED REGISTERED NURSES.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.233.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Registered nurse.</span></h2>
          <p>A registered nurse certified in a specialized field of professional nursing as described in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.171#stat.148.171.22">148.171, subdivision 22</a>, shall use the designation RN,C for personal identification and in documentation of services provided. Identification of educational degrees and specialty fields may be added.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.233.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Advanced practice registered nurse.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) Only those persons who hold a current license to practice advanced practice registered nursing in this state may use the title advanced practice registered nurse with the role designation of certified registered nurse anesthetist, certified nurse-midwife, certified clinical nurse specialist, or certified nurse practitioner.</p>
          <p>(b) An advanced practice registered nurse shall use the appropriate designation: APRN, CNS; APRN, CNM; APRN, CNP; or APRN, CRNA for personal identification and in documentation of services provided. Identification of educational degrees and specialty fields may be added.</p>
          <p>(c) When providing nursing care, an advanced practice registered nurse shall provide clear identification of the appropriate advanced practice registered nurse designation.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.233.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/172/#laws.0.4.0">1999 c 172 s 4</a>,18; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.24.0">2014 c 235 s 24</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.234">
        <h1 class="shn">148.234 STATE BOUNDARIES CONSIDERATION.</h1>
        <p>A nurse may perform patient care procedures and techniques at the direction of a physician, a podiatrist, a dentist, or an advanced practice registered nurse licensed in another state, United States territory, or Canadian province if the physician, podiatrist, dentist, or advanced practice registered nurse gave the direction after examining the patient and issued the direction in that state, United States territory, or Canadian province.</p>
        <p>Nothing in this section allows a nurse to perform a patient care procedure or technique at the direction of a physician, a podiatrist, a dentist, or an advanced practice registered nurse that is illegal in this state.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.234.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1996/0/318/#laws.0.2.0">1996 c 318 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.25.0">2014 c 235 s 25</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.235">
        <h1 class="shn">148.235 PRESCRIBING DRUGS AND THERAPEUTIC DEVICES.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.42.0">2014 c 235 s 42</a>; 2014 c 312 art 24 s 43]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.42.0">2014 c 235 s 42</a>; 2014 c 312 art 24 s 43]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.2a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2a.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.42.0">2014 c 235 s 42;</a> 2014 c 312 art 24 s 43]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed by amendment, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/172/#laws.0.5.0">1999 c 172 s 5</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.42.0">2014 c 235 s 42</a>; 2014 c 312 art 24 s 43]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.4a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4a.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.42.0">2014 c 235 s 42</a>; 2014 c 312 art 24 s 43]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.4b">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4b.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.42.0">2014 c 235 s 42</a>; 2014 c 312 art 24 s 43]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed by amendment, 1999 c 172 c 5]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.6">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 6.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.42.0">2014 c 235 s 42</a>; 2014 c 312 art 24 s 43]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.7">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 7.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.42.0">2014 c 235 s 42</a>; 2014 c 312 art 24 s 43]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.7a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 7a.<span class="headnote">Diagnosis, prescribing, and ordering.</span></h2>
          <p>Advanced practice registered nurses are authorized to:</p>
          <p>(1) diagnose, prescribe, and institute therapy or referrals of patients to health care agencies and providers;</p>
          <p>(2) prescribe, procure, sign for, record, administer, and dispense over-the-counter, legend, and controlled substances, including sample drugs; and</p>
          <p>(3) plan and initiate a therapeutic regimen that includes ordering and prescribing durable medical devices and equipment, nutrition, diagnostic services, and supportive services including, but not limited to, home health care, hospice, physical therapy, and occupational therapy.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.7b">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 7b.<span class="headnote">Drug Enforcement Administration requirements.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) Advanced practice registered nurses must:</p>
          <p>(1) comply with federal Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) requirements related to controlled substances; and</p>
          <p>(2) file any and all of the nurse's DEA registrations and numbers with the board.</p>
          <p>(b) The board shall maintain current records of all advanced practice registered nurses with DEA registration and numbers.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.8">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 8.<span class="headnote">Prescription by protocol.</span></h2>
          <p>A registered nurse may implement a protocol that does not reference a specific patient and results in a prescription of a legend drug that has been predetermined and delegated by a licensed practitioner as defined under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/151.01#stat.151.01.23">151.01, subdivision 23</a>, when caring for a patient whose condition falls within the protocol and when the protocol specifies the circumstances under which the drug is to be prescribed or administered.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.9">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 9.<span class="headnote">Vaccine by protocol.</span></h2>
          <p>A nurse may implement a protocol that does not reference a specific patient and results in the administration of a vaccine that has been predetermined and delegated by a licensed practitioner as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/151.01#stat.151.01.23">151.01, subdivision 23</a>, when caring for a patient whose characteristics fall within the protocol and when the protocol specifies the contraindications for implementation, including patients or populations of patients for whom the vaccine must not be administered and the conditions under which the vaccine must not be administered.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.10">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 10.<span class="headnote">Administration of medications by unlicensed personnel in nursing facilities.</span></h2>
          <p>Notwithstanding the provisions of Minnesota Rules, part <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/rules/4658.1360">4658.1360</a>, subpart 2, a graduate of a foreign nursing school who has successfully completed an approved competency evaluation under the provisions of section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/144A.61">144A.61</a> is eligible to administer medications in a nursing facility upon completion of a medication training program for unlicensed personnel offered through a postsecondary educational institution, which meets the requirements specified in Minnesota Rules, part <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/rules/4658.1360">4658.1360</a>, subpart 2, item B.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.11">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 11.<span class="headnote">Dispensing by protocol.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">Subject to the requirements of this subdivision, a registered nurse in a family planning agency as defined in Minnesota Rules, part <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/rules/9505.0280">9505.0280</a>, subpart 3, may dispense contraceptives prescribed by a licensed practitioner as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/151.01#stat.151.01.23">151.01, subdivision 23</a>, pursuant to a dispensing protocol established by the agency's medical director or under the direction of a physician. The dispensing protocol must address the requirements of sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/151.01#stat.151.01.30">151.01, subdivision 30, </a>and <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/151.212#stat.151.212.1">151.212, subdivision 1</a>. In addition, the registered nurse may not dispense contraceptives if the patient is under 12 years of age.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.235.12">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 12.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2008/0/321/#laws.0.8.0">2008 c 321 s 8</a>]</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.235.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1990/0/483/#laws.0.2.0">1990 c 483 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/337/#laws.0.10.0">1993 c 337 s 10</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1994/0/389/#laws.0.2.0">1994 c 389 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1994/0/470/#laws.0.1.0">1994 c 470 s 1</a>-3; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1996/0/446/#laws.1.67.0">1996 c 446 art 1 s 67</a>,68; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1996/0/451/#laws.6.1.0">1996 c 451 art 6 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1997/0/7/#laws.1.77.0">1997 c 7 art 1 s 77</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/172/#laws.0.5.0">1999 c 172 s 5</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2002/0/362/#laws.0.1.0">2002 c 362 s 1</a>,2; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2003/0/87/#laws.0.5.0">2003 c 87 s 5</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/139/#laws.0.2.0">2007 c 139 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/147/#laws.11.3.0">2007 c 147 art 11 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2008/0/321/#laws.0.2.0">2008 c 321 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.26.0">2014 c 235 s 26</a>,27</p>
      </div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.236"><b>148.236</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1995/0/212/#laws.3.60.0">1995 c 212 art 3 s 60</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1995/0/234/#laws.8.57.0">1995 c 234 art 8 s 57</a>]</div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.24"><b>148.24</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.14.0">1945 c 242 s 14</a>]</div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.241">
        <h1 class="shn">148.241 EXPENSES.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.241.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Appropriation.</span></h2>
          <p>The expenses of administering sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.171">148.171</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.285">148.285</a> shall be paid from the appropriation made to the Minnesota Board of Nursing.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.241.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Expenditure.</span></h2>
          <p>All amounts appropriated to the board shall be held subject to the order of the board to be used only for the purpose of meeting necessary expenses incurred in the performance of the purposes of sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.171">148.171</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.285">148.285</a>, and the duties imposed thereby as well as the promotion of nursing education and standards of nursing care in this state.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.241.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1945/0/242/#laws.0.8.0">1945 c 242 s 8</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1955/0/34/#laws.0.3.0">1955 c 34 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1973/0/638/#laws.0.16.0">1973 c 638 s 16</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1976/0/222/#laws.0.54.0">1976 c 222 s 54</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1989/0/194/#laws.0.10.0">1989 c 194 s 10</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.242">
        <h1 class="shn">148.242 FEES.</h1>
        <p>The fees specified in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.243">148.243</a> are nonrefundable and must be deposited in the state government special revenue fund.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.242.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first">
          <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2011/1/9/#laws.5.6.0">1Sp2011 c 9 art 5 s 6</a>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.243">
        <h1 class="shn">148.243 FEE AMOUNTS.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Licensure by examination.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for licensure by examination is $105.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Reexamination fee.</span></h2>
          <p>The reexamination fee is $60.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Licensure by endorsement.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for licensure by endorsement is $105.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Registration renewal.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for registration renewal is $85.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.<span class="headnote">Reregistration.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for reregistration is $105.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.6">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 6.<span class="headnote">Replacement license.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for a replacement license is $20.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.7">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 7.<span class="headnote">Public health nurse certification.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for public health nurse certification is $30.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.8">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 8.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/235/#laws.0.42.0">2014 c 235 s 42</a>; 2014 c 312 art 24 s 43]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.9">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 9.<span class="headnote">Licensure verification other than through Nursys.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for verification of licensure status other than through Nursys verification is $20.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.10">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 10.<span class="headnote">Verification of examination scores.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for verification of examination scores is $20.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.11">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 11.<span class="headnote">Microfilmed licensure application materials.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for a copy of microfilmed licensure application materials is $20.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.12">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 12.<span class="headnote">Nursing business registration; initial application.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for the initial application for nursing business registration is $100.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.13">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 13.<span class="headnote">Nursing business registration; annual application.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for the annual application for nursing business registration is $25.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.14">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 14.<span class="headnote">Practicing without current registration.</span></h2>
          <p>The fee for practicing without current registration is two times the amount of the current registration renewal fee for any part of the first calendar month, plus the current registration renewal fee for any part of any subsequent month up to 24 months.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.15">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 15.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2017/0/57/#laws.0.6.0">2017 c 57 s 6</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.243.16">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 16.<span class="headnote">Dishonored check fee.</span></h2>
          <p>The service fee for a dishonored check is as provided in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/604.113">604.113</a>.</p>
        </div>
