The physical therapy aide may perform tasks related to preparation of patient and equipment for treatment, housekeeping, transportation, clerical duties, departmental maintenance, and selected treatment procedures. The tasks must be performed under the direct supervision of a physical therapist who is readily available for advice, instruction, or immediate assistance.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.706.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1980/0/412/#laws.0.11.0">1980 c 412 s 11</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1986/0/444/#laws.0.0.0">1986 c 444</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2005/0/147/#laws.2.6.0">2005 c 147 art 2 s 6</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.20.0">2007 c 123 s 20</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.71">
        <h1 class="shn">148.71 TEMPORARY PERMITS.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.71.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.</h2>
          <p> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.137.0">2007 c 123 s 137</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.71.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Issuance.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">(a) The board may, upon completion of the application prescribed by the board and payment of a fee set by the board, issue a temporary permit to practice physical therapy under supervision to an applicant for licensure as a physical therapist or physical therapist assistant who meets the educational requirements of section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.721">148.721</a> or <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.722">148.722</a> and qualified for admission to examination for licensing as a physical therapist or physical therapist assistant. A temporary permit may be issued only once and cannot be renewed. It expires 90 days after the next examination for licensing given by the board or on the date on which the board, after examination of the applicant, grants or denies the applicant a license to practice, whichever occurs first. A temporary permit expires on the first day the board begins its next examination for license after the permit is issued if the holder does not submit to examination on that date. The holder of a temporary permit to practice under supervision may practice physical therapy as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.65">148.65</a> if the entire practice is under the supervision of a person holding a valid license to practice physical therapy in this state. The supervision shall be direct, immediate, and on premises.</p>
          <p class="in">(b) An applicant from another state who is licensed or otherwise registered in good standing as a physical therapist by that state and meets the requirements for licensing under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.721">148.721</a> does not require supervision to practice physical therapy while holding a temporary permit in this state. The temporary permit remains valid only until the meeting of the board at which the application for licensing is considered.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.71.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote"> Foreign-educated physical therapists; temporary permits.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">(a) The Board of Physical Therapy may issue a temporary permit to a foreign-educated physical therapist who:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) is enrolled in a supervised physical therapy traineeship that meets the requirements under paragraph (b);</p>
          <p class="in">(2) has completed a physical therapy education program equivalent to that under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.721">148.721</a>, and has provided to the board a Foreign Credentialing Commission on Physical Therapy (FCCPT) comprehensive credentials evaluation (Type I certificate) or FCCPT educational credentials review demonstrating completion of the program;</p>
          <p class="in">(3) has achieved a passing score according to section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.725">148.725</a>, subdivision 3, on the test of English as a foreign language or an alternate equivalent examination, as determined by the board; and</p>
          <p class="in">(4) has paid a nonrefundable fee set by the board.</p>
          <p class="in">A foreign-educated physical therapist must have the temporary permit before beginning a traineeship.</p>
          <p class="in">(b) A supervised physical therapy traineeship must:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) be at least six months;</p>
          <p class="in">(2) be at a board-approved facility;</p>
          <p class="in">(3) provide a broad base of clinical experience to the foreign-educated physical therapist including a variety of physical agents, therapeutic exercises, evaluation procedures, and patient diagnoses;</p>
          <p class="in">(4) be supervised by a physical therapist who has at least three years of clinical experience and is licensed under subdivision 1; and</p>
          <p class="in">(5) be approved by the board before the foreign-educated physical therapist begins the traineeship.</p>
          <p class="in">(c) A temporary permit is effective on the first day of a traineeship and expires 90 days after the next examination for licensing given by the board following successful completion of the traineeship or on the date on which the board, after examination of the applicant, grants or denies the applicant a license to practice, whichever occurs first.</p>
          <p class="in">(d) A foreign-educated physical therapist must successfully complete a traineeship to be licensed as a physical therapist under subdivision 1. The traineeship may be waived for a foreign-educated physical therapist who is licensed or otherwise registered in good standing in another state and has successfully practiced physical therapy in that state under the supervision of a licensed or registered physical therapist for at least six months at a facility that meets the requirements under paragraph (b), clauses (2) and (3).</p>
          <p class="in">(e) A temporary permit will not be issued to a foreign-educated applicant who has been issued a temporary permit for longer than six months in any other state.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.71.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1951/0/479/#laws.0.7.0">1951 c 479 s 7</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1980/0/412/#laws.0.5.0">1980 c 412 s 5</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1988/0/557/#laws.0.4.0">1988 c 557 s 4</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1991/0/106/#laws.0.6.0">1991 c 106 s 6</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/21/#laws.0.11.0">1993 c 21 s 11</a>,12; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/245/#laws.9.53.0">1999 c 245 art 9 s 53</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2002/0/379/#laws.1.51.0">2002 c 379 art 1 s 51</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.21.0">2007 c 123 s 21</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2009/0/86/#laws.1.20.0">2009 c 86 art 1 s 20</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.715">
        <h1 class="shn">148.715 FEES.</h1>
        <p class="in">The fees charged by the board are fixed at the following rates:</p>
        <p class="in">(1) application fee for physical therapists and physical therapist assistants, $100;</p>
        <p class="in">(2) annual licensure for physical therapists and physical therapist assistants, $60;</p>
        <p class="in">(3) licensure renewal late fee, $20;</p>
        <p class="in">(4) temporary permit, $25;</p>
        <p class="in">(5) duplicate license or registration, $20;</p>
        <p class="in">(6) certification letter, $25;</p>
        <p class="in">(7) education or training program approval, $100;</p>
        <p class="in">(8) report creation and generation, $60 per hour billed in quarter-hour increments with a quarter-hour minimum; and</p>
        <p class="in">(9) examination administration:</p>
        <p class="in">(i) half day, $50; and</p>
        <p class="in">(ii) full day, $80.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.715.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.36.0">2007 c 123 s 36</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/147/#laws.9.26.0">2007 c 147 art 9 s 26</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.72"><b>148.72</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.137.0">2007 c 123 s 137</a>]</div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.721">
        <h1 class="shn">148.721 EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS FOR LICENSED PHYSICAL THERAPIST.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.721.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Accredited program.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">All applicants for licensure as a physical therapist must complete a course in physical therapy education accredited by the Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education (CAPTE) or which meets the accreditation requirements of CAPTE, as determined by the board.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.721.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">General education.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">In addition to completion of the accredited program required in subdivision 1, applicants must complete an additional 60 academic semester credits or its quarter equivalent from an institution of higher education that is accredited by a regional accrediting organization. Coursework used to satisfy this requirement may not have been earned as part of the accredited program requirement of subdivision 1.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.721.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first">
          <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.22.0">2007 c 123 s 22</a>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.722">
        <h1 class="shn">148.722 EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS FOR LICENSED PHYSICAL THERAPIST ASSISTANT.</h1>
        <p class="in">All applicants for licensure as a physical therapist assistant must graduate from a physical therapist assistant educational program accredited by the Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education (CAPTE) or meet its standards, as determined by the board.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.722.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first">
          <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.23.0">2007 c 123 s 23</a>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.723">
        <h1 class="shn">148.723 EXAMINATION FOR LICENSED PHYSICAL THERAPIST.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.723.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">National test.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">All applicants for licensure as a physical therapist must take and pass the National Physical Therapy Examination (NPTE) administered by the Federation of State Boards of Physical Therapy (FSBPT) or an alternate national examination determined by the board to be equivalent. For purposes of this section, passing scores are defined in subdivisions 2 and 3.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.723.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Examinations taken on or before July 1, 1995.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">The passing score for qualifying examinations taken prior to July 1, 1995, is one standard deviation below the mean of all persons taking the examination.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.723.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Examinations taken after July 1, 1995.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">The passing score for qualifying examinations taken after July 1, 1995, shall be based on objective, numerical standards established by the administering testing agency.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.723.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first">
          <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.24.0">2007 c 123 s 24</a>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.724">
        <h1 class="shn">148.724 EXAMINATION FOR LICENSED PHYSICAL THERAPIST ASSISTANT.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.724.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">National test.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">All applicants for licensure as a physical therapist assistant must take and pass the National Physical Therapy Examination (NPTE) for physical therapist assistants administered by the Federation of State Boards of Physical Therapy (FSBPT) or an alternate national examination determined by the board to be equivalent. For purposes of this section, passing scores are defined in subdivisions 2 and 3.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.724.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Examinations taken on or before July 1, 1995.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">The passing score for qualifying examinations taken prior to July 1, 1995, is one standard deviation below the mean of all persons taking the examination.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.724.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Examinations taken after July 1, 1995.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">The passing score for qualifying examinations taken after July 1, 1995, shall be based on objective, numerical standards established by the administering testing agency.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.724.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.</h2>
          <p>MS 2007 Supp [Expired, 2007 c123 s 25]</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.724.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.25.0">2007 c 123 s 25</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2023/0/25/#laws.0.52.0">2023 c 25 s 52</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.725">
        <h1 class="shn">148.725 REQUIREMENTS FOR FOREIGN-EDUCATED APPLICANTS.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.725.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Scope and documentation.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">An applicant for licensure who is a foreign-educated physical therapist must fulfill the requirements in subdivisions 2 to 5, providing certified English translations of board-required relevant documentation.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.725.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Education evaluation.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">The applicant must present evidence of completion of physical therapy schooling equivalent to that required in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.721">148.721</a> by having a Type I comprehensive credentials evaluation or educational credentials review performed by the Foreign Credentialing Commission on Physical Therapy (FCCPT). The evaluation must be sent directly to the board from the FCCPT. The applicant shall be responsible for the expenses incurred as a result of the evaluation.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.725.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">English test.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">If not completed as part of the FCCPT Type I comprehensive credentials evaluation, the applicant must demonstrate English language proficiency by taking the test of English as a foreign language examination (TOEFL) and achieving a passing score as established by the board, or a passing score on a comparable nationally recognized examination approved by the board. For purposes of this subdivision, the passing score adopted by the board shall be applied prospectively.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.725.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Experience.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">The applicant must have practiced satisfactorily for at least six months under the supervision of a licensed physical therapist at a board-approved facility. A facility that offers such practice must provide a broad base of experience including a variety of physical agents, therapeutic exercises, evaluation procedures, and patient diagnoses. Supervision must be provided by a licensed physical therapist with at least three years of clinical experience. A proposed outline of clinical experiences must be approved by the board before the facility begins offering the experience.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.725.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.<span class="headnote">Examination.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">The applicant must satisfactorily complete the board-approved examination as stated in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.723">148.723</a>.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.725.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.26.0">2007 c 123 s 26</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2009/0/86/#laws.1.21.0">2009 c 86 art 1 s 21</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2017/0/40/#laws.1.36.0">2017 c 40 art 1 s 36</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.73">
        <h1 class="shn">148.73 RENEWALS.</h1>
        <p class="in">Every licensed physical therapist and physical therapist assistant shall, before January 1 each year, apply to the board for an extension of a license and pay a fee in the amount set by the board. The extension of the license is contingent upon demonstration that the continuing education requirements set by the board under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.70">148.70</a> have been satisfied. For purposes of this section, the continuing education requirements for physical therapist assistants are the same as those for physical therapists.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.73.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1951/0/479/#laws.0.9.0">1951 c 479 s 9</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1959/0/282/#laws.0.1.0">1959 c 282 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1961/0/323/#laws.0.1.0">1961 c 323 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1980/0/412/#laws.0.7.0">1980 c 412 s 7</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1986/0/444/#laws.0.0.0">1986 c 444</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1988/0/549/#laws.0.2.0">1988 c 549 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/245/#laws.9.57.0">1999 c 245 art 9 s 57</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.27.0">2007 c 123 s 27</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.735">
        <h1 class="shn">148.735 CANCELLATION OF LICENSE IN GOOD STANDING.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.735.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Board approval; reporting.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">A physical therapist or physical therapist assistant holding an active license to practice physical therapy in the state may, upon approval of the board, be granted license cancellation if the board is not investigating the person as a result of a complaint or information received or if the board has not begun disciplinary proceedings against the person. Such action by the board shall be reported as a cancellation of a license in good standing.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.735.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Fees nonrefundable.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">A physical therapist or physical therapist assistant who receives board approval for license cancellation is not entitled to a refund of any license fees paid for the licensure year in which cancellation of the license occurred.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.735.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">New license after cancellation.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">If a physical therapist or physical therapist assistant who has been granted board approval for license cancellation desires to resume the practice of physical therapy in Minnesota, that physical therapist or physical therapist assistant must obtain a new license by applying for licensure and fulfilling the requirements then in existence for obtaining an initial license to practice physical therapy in Minnesota.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.735.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2005/0/147/#laws.2.7.0">2005 c 147 art 2 s 7</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.28.0">2007 c 123 s 28</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.736">
        <h1 class="shn">148.736 CANCELLATION OF CREDENTIALS UNDER DISCIPLINARY ORDER.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.736.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Board approval; reporting.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">A physical therapist or physical therapist assistant whose right to practice is under suspension, condition, limitation, qualification, or restriction by the board may be granted cancellation of credentials by approval of the board. Such action by the board shall be reported as cancellation while under discipline. Credentials, for purposes of this section, means board authorized documentation of the privilege to practice physical therapy.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.736.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Fees nonrefundable.</span></h2>
          <p>A physical therapist or physical therapist assistant who receives board approval for credential cancellation is not entitled to a refund of any fees paid for the credentialing year in which cancellation of the credential occurred.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.736.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">New credential after cancellation.</span></h2>
          <p>If a physical therapist or physical therapist assistant who has been granted board approval for credential cancellation desires to resume the practice of physical therapy in Minnesota, that physical therapist or physical therapist assistant must obtain a new credential by applying to the board and fulfilling the requirements then in existence for obtaining an initial credential to practice physical therapy in Minnesota.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.736.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2005/0/147/#laws.2.8.0">2005 c 147 art 2 s 8</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.29.0">2007 c 123 s 29</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2008/0/277/#laws.1.19.0">2008 c 277 art 1 s 19</a>,20</p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.737">
        <h1 class="shn">148.737 CANCELLATION OF LICENSE FOR NONRENEWAL.</h1>
        <p>The Board of Physical Therapy shall not renew, reissue, reinstate, or restore a license that has lapsed on or after January 1, 2006, and has not been renewed within two annual license renewal cycles starting January 1, 2008. A licensee whose license is canceled for nonrenewal must obtain a new license by applying for licensure and fulfilling all requirements then in existence for an initial license to practice physical therapy in Minnesota.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.737.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first">
          <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2005/0/147/#laws.2.9.0">2005 c 147 art 2 s 9</a>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.74">
        <h1 class="shn">148.74 RULES.</h1>
        <p class="in">The board may adopt rules needed to carry out sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.65">148.65</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.78">148.78</a>.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.74.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1951/0/479/#laws.0.10.0">1951 c 479 s 10</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1977/0/305/#laws.0.45.0">1977 c 305 s 45</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1980/0/412/#laws.0.8.0">1980 c 412 s 8</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1985/0/248/#laws.0.70.0">1985 c 248 s 70</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1988/0/549/#laws.0.3.0">1988 c 549 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/245/#laws.9.58.0">1999 c 245 art 9 s 58</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.30.0">2007 c 123 s 30</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.741">
        <h1 class="shn">148.741 APPLICABILITY OF RULES.</h1>
        <p>Minnesota Rules, parts <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/rules/5601.0100">5601.0100</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/rules/5601.3200">5601.3200</a>, apply both to physical therapists and physical therapist assistants, except parts <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/rules/5601.1300">5601.1300</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/rules/5601.2000">5601.2000</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/rules/5601.3200">5601.3200</a>, subpart 2, item D; and <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/rules/5601.3200">5601.3200</a>, subpart 5, only apply to physical therapists.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.741.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.135.0">2007 c 123 s 135</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2013/0/125/#laws.1.33.0">2013 c 125 art 1 s 33</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2016/0/158/#laws.1.68.0">2016 c 158 art 1 s 68</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.745"><b>148.745</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.137.0">2007 c 123 s 137</a>]</div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.75">
        <h1 class="shn">148.75 DISCIPLINARY ACTION.</h1>
        <p class="in">(a) The board may impose disciplinary action specified in paragraph (b) against an applicant or licensee whom the board, by a preponderance of the evidence, determines:</p>
        <p class="in">(1) has violated a statute, rule, order, or agreement for corrective action that the board issued or is otherwise authorized or empowered to enforce;</p>
        <p class="in">(2) is unable to practice physical therapy with reasonable skill and safety by reason of any mental or physical illness or condition, including deterioration through the aging process or loss of motor skills, or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material;</p>
        <p class="in">(3) has been convicted of or has pled guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or other crime, an element of which is dishonesty or fraud, or has been shown to have engaged in acts or practices tending to show that the applicant or licensee is incompetent or has engaged in conduct reflecting adversely on the applicant's or licensee's ability or fitness to engage in the practice of physical therapy;</p>
        <p class="in">(4) has been convicted of violating any state or federal narcotic law;</p>
        <p class="in">(5) has obtained or attempted to obtain a license or approval of continuing education activities, or passed an examination, by fraud or deception;</p>
        <p class="in">(6) has engaged in unprofessional conduct or any other conduct which has the potential for causing harm to the public, including any departure from or failure to conform to the minimum standards of acceptable and prevailing practice without actual injury having to be established;</p>
        <p class="in">(7) has engaged in gross negligence in the practice of physical therapy as a physical therapist;</p>
        <p class="in">(8) has treated human ailments by physical therapy after an initial 90-day period of patient admittance to treatment has lapsed, except by the order or referral of a person licensed in this state in the practice of medicine as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/147.081">147.081</a>, the practice of chiropractic as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.01">148.01</a>, the practice of podiatry as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/153.01">153.01</a>, or the practice of dentistry as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/150A.05">150A.05</a>, or the practice of advance practice nursing as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.171#stat.148.171.3">148.171, subdivision 3</a>, when orders or referrals are made in and whose license is in collaboration with a physician, chiropractor, podiatrist, or dentist, and whose license is in good standing; or when a previous diagnosis exists indicating an ongoing condition warranting physical therapy treatment, subject to periodic review defined by board of physical therapy rule. The 90-day limitation of treatment by a physical therapist without an order or referral does not apply to prevention, wellness, education, or exercise;</p>
        <p class="in">(9) for a physical therapist licensed less than one year, has treated human ailments, without referral, by physical therapy treatment without first having practiced one year in collaboration with a physical therapist with more than one year of experience or under a physician's orders or referrals as verified by the board's records;</p>
        <p class="in">(10) has failed to consult with the patient's licensed health care provider, or licensed health care professional, who prescribed the physical therapy treatment if the treatment is altered by the physical therapist from the original written order. The provision does not include written orders to "evaluate and treat";</p>
        <p class="in">(11) has inappropriately delegated to a physical therapist assistant or inappropriately assigned tasks to an aide, or inadequately supervised a student physical therapist, physical therapist assistant, student physical therapist assistant, or a physical therapy aide;</p>
        <p class="in">(12) has practiced as a physical therapist performing medical diagnosis, the practice of medicine as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/147.081">147.081</a>, or the practice of chiropractic as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.01">148.01</a>;</p>
        <p class="in">(13) has failed to comply with a reasonable request to obtain appropriate clearance for mental or physical conditions that would interfere with the ability to practice physical therapy, and that may be potentially harmful to patients;</p>
        <p class="in">(14) has divided fees with, or paying or promising to pay a commission or part of the fee to, any person who contacts the physical therapist for consultation or sends patients to the physical therapist for treatment;</p>
        <p class="in">(15) has engaged in an incentive payment arrangement, other than that prohibited by clause (14), that tends to promote physical therapy overuse, that allows the referring person or person who controls the availability of physical therapy services to a client to profit unreasonably as a result of patient treatment;</p>
        <p class="in">(16) has failed to refer to a licensed health care professional a patient whose medical condition has been determined by the physical therapist to be beyond the scope of practice of a physical therapist;</p>
        <p class="in">(17) has failed to report to the board other licensees who violate this section;</p>
        <p class="in">(18) has engaged in the practice of physical therapy under lapsed or nonrenewed credentials;</p>
        <p class="in">(19) has had a license, certificate, charter, registration, privilege to take an examination, or other similar authority denied, revoked, suspended, canceled, limited, reprimanded, or otherwise disciplined, or not renewed for cause in any jurisdiction; or has surrendered or voluntarily terminated a license or certificate during a board investigation of a complaint, as part of a disciplinary order, or while under a disciplinary order;</p>
        <p class="in">(20) has been subject to a corrective action or similar action in another jurisdiction or by another regulatory authority; or</p>
        <p class="in">(21) has failed to cooperate with an investigation of the board, including responding fully and promptly to any question raised by or on behalf of the board relating to the subject of the investigation, executing all releases requested by the board, providing copies of patient records, as reasonably requested by the board to assist it in its investigation, and appearing at conferences or hearings scheduled by the board or its staff.</p>
        <p class="in">(b) If grounds for disciplinary action exist under paragraph (a), the board may take one or more of the following actions:</p>
        <p class="in">(1) deny the application for licensure;</p>
        <p class="in">(2) deny the renewal of the license;</p>
        <p class="in">(3) revoke the license;</p>
        <p class="in">(4) suspend the license;</p>
        <p class="in">(5) impose limitations or conditions on the licensee's practice of physical therapy, including the: (i) limitation of scope of practice to designated field specialties; (ii) imposition of retraining or rehabilitation requirements; (iii) requirement of practice under supervision; or (iv) conditioning of continued practice on demonstration of knowledge or skills by appropriate examination, monitoring, or other review of skill and competence;</p>
        <p class="in">(6) impose a civil penalty not to exceed $10,000 for each separate violation, the amount of the civil penalty to be fixed so as to deprive the physical therapist of any economic advantage gained by reason of the violation charged, to discourage similar violations, or to reimburse the board for the cost of the investigation and proceeding including, but not limited to, fees paid for services provided by the Office of Administrative Hearings, legal and investigative services provided by the Office of the Attorney General, court reporters, witnesses, reproduction of records, board members' per diem compensation, board staff time, and travel costs and expenses incurred by board staff and board members;</p>
        <p class="in">(7) order the licensee to provide unremunerated service;</p>
        <p class="in">(8) censure or reprimand the licensee; or</p>
        <p class="in">(9) any other action as allowed by law and justified by the facts of the case.</p>
        <p class="in">(c) A license to practice as a physical therapist or physical therapist assistant is automatically suspended if (1) a guardian of the licensee is appointed by order of a court pursuant to sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/524.5-101">524.5-101</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/524.5-502">524.5-502</a>, for reasons other than the minority of the licensee; or (2) the licensee is committed by order of a court pursuant to chapter 253B. The license remains suspended until the licensee is restored to capacity by a court and, upon petition by the licensee, the suspension is terminated by the Board of Physical Therapy after a hearing.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.75.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1951/0/479/#laws.0.11.0">1951 c 479 s 11</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1967/0/119/#laws.0.1.0">1967 c 119 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1969/0/6/#laws.0.27.0">1969 c 6 s 27</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1969/0/927/#laws.0.7.0">1969 c 927 s 7</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1974/0/61/#laws.0.1.0">1974 c 61 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1974/0/406/#laws.0.23.0">1974 c 406 s 23</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1980/0/412/#laws.0.9.0">1980 c 412 s 9</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1982/0/581/#laws.0.24.0">1982 c 581 s 24</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1985/0/182/#laws.0.2.0">1985 c 182 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1986/0/444/#laws.0.0.0">1986 c 444</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1987/0/384/#laws.2.1.0">1987 c 384 art 2 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1988/0/549/#laws.0.4.0">1988 c 549 s 4</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1991/0/106/#laws.0.6.0">1991 c 106 s 6</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1991/0/199/#laws.2.1.0">1991 c 199 art 2 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1994/1/1/#laws.2.11.0">1Sp1994 c 1 art 2 s 11</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/245/#laws.9.60.0">1999 c 245 art 9 s 60</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2004/0/146/#laws.3.9.0">2004 c 146 art 3 s 9</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2005/0/147/#laws.2.10.0">2005 c 147 art 2 s 10</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.31.0">2007 c 123 s 31</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2008/0/199/#laws.0.2.0">2008 c 199 s 2</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.754">
        <h1 class="shn">148.754 EXAMINATION; ACCESS TO MEDICAL DATA.</h1>
        <p class="in">(a) If the board has probable cause to believe that a licensee comes under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.75">148.75, paragraph (a)</a>, clause (2), it may direct the licensee to submit to a mental or physical examination. For the purpose of this paragraph, every licensee is deemed to have consented to submit to a mental or physical examination when directed in writing by the board and further to have waived all objections to the admissibility of the examining physicians' testimony or examination reports on the ground that they constitute a privileged communication. Failure of the licensee to submit to an examination when directed constitutes an admission of the allegations against the person, unless the failure was due to circumstances beyond the person's control, in which case a default and final order may be entered without the taking of testimony or presentation of evidence. A licensee affected under this paragraph shall, at reasonable intervals, be given an opportunity to demonstrate that the person can resume the competent practice of physical therapy with reasonable skill and safety to the public.</p>
        <p class="in">(b) In any proceeding under paragraph (a), neither the record of proceedings nor the orders entered by the board shall be used against a licensee in any other proceeding.</p>
        <p class="in">(c) In addition to ordering a physical or mental examination, the board may, notwithstanding section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/13.384">13.384</a>, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/144.651">144.651</a>, or any other law limiting access to medical or other health data, obtain medical data and health records relating to a licensee or applicant without the person's or applicant's consent if the board has probable cause to believe that the person comes under paragraph (a). The medical data may be requested from a provider, as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/144.291#stat.144.291.2">144.291, subdivision 2</a>, paragraph (i), an insurance company, or a government agency, including the Department of Human Services. A provider, insurance company, or government agency shall comply with any written request of the board under this paragraph and is not liable in any action for damages for releasing the data requested by the board if the data are released pursuant to a written request under this paragraph, unless the information is false and the provider giving the information knew, or had reason to believe, the information was false. Information obtained under this paragraph is classified as private under sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/13.01">13.01</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/13.87">13.87</a>.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.754.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2005/0/147/#laws.2.11.0">2005 c 147 art 2 s 11</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.32.0">2007 c 123 s 32</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/147/#laws.10.15.0">2007 c 147 art 10 s 15</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2020/0/83/#laws.2.10.0">2020 c 83 art 2 s 10</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.755">
        <h1 class="shn">148.755 TEMPORARY SUSPENSION OF LICENSE.</h1>
        <p class="in">In addition to any other remedy provided by law, the board may, without a hearing, temporarily suspend the license of a licensee if the board finds that the licensee has violated a statute or rule which the board is empowered to enforce and continued practice by the licensee would create a serious risk of harm to the public. The suspension shall take effect upon written notice to the licensee, specifying the statute or rule violated. The suspension shall remain in effect until the board issues a final order in the matter after a hearing. At the time it issues the suspension notice, the board shall schedule a disciplinary hearing to be held pursuant to the Administrative Procedure Act, chapter 14. The licensee shall be provided with at least 20 days' notice of any hearing held pursuant to this section. The hearing shall be scheduled to begin no later than 30 days after the issuance of the suspension order.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.755.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2005/0/147/#laws.2.12.0">2005 c 147 art 2 s 12</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.33.0">2007 c 123 s 33</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.76">
        <h1 class="shn">148.76 PROHIBITED CONDUCT.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.76.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Licensure required.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">No person shall:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) provide physical therapy unless the person is licensed as a physical therapist or physical therapist assistant under sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.65">148.65</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.78">148.78</a>;</p>
          <p class="in">(2) use the title of physical therapist without a license as a physical therapist or use the title physical therapist assistant without a license as a physical therapist assistant issued under sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.65">148.65</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.78">148.78</a>;</p>
          <p class="in">(3) in any manner hold out as a physical therapist, or use in connection with the person's name the words or letters Physical Therapist, Physiotherapist, Physical Therapy Technician, Registered Physical Therapist, Licensed Physical Therapist, PT, PTT, RPT, LPT, or any letters, words, abbreviations or insignia indicating or implying that the person is a physical therapist, without a license as a physical therapist issued under sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.65">148.65</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.78">148.78</a>. To do so is a gross misdemeanor;</p>
          <p class="in">(4) in any manner hold out as a physical therapist assistant, or use in connection with the person's name the words or letters Physical Therapist Assistant, P.T.A., or any letters, words, abbreviations, or insignia indicating or implying that the person is a physical therapist assistant, without a license as a physical therapist assistant under sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.65">148.65</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.78">148.78</a>. To do so is a gross misdemeanor; or</p>
          <p class="in">(5) employ fraud or deception in applying for or securing a license as a physical therapist or physical therapist assistant.</p>
          <p class="in">Nothing in sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.65">148.65</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.78">148.78</a> prohibits a person licensed or registered in this state under another law from carrying out the therapy or practice for which the person is duly licensed or registered.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.76.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Prohibitions.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">(a) No physical therapist may:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) treat human ailments by physical therapy after an initial 90-day period of patient admittance to treatment has lapsed, except by the order or referral of a person licensed in this state to practice medicine as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/147.081">147.081</a>, the practice of chiropractic as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.01">148.01</a>, the practice of podiatry as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/153.01">153.01</a>, the practice of dentistry as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/150A.05">150A.05</a>, or the practice of advanced practice nursing as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/62A.15#stat.62A.15.3a">62A.15, subdivision 3a</a>, when orders or referrals are made in collaboration with a physician, chiropractor, podiatrist, or dentist, and whose license is in good standing; or when a previous diagnosis exists indicating an ongoing condition warranting physical therapy treatment, subject to periodic review defined by Board of Physical Therapy rule. The 90-day limitation of treatment by a physical therapist without an order or referral does not apply to prevention, wellness, education, or exercise;</p>
          <p class="in">(2) use any chiropractic manipulative technique whose end is the chiropractic adjustment of an abnormal articulation of the body; and</p>
          <p class="in">(3) treat human ailments other than by physical therapy unless duly licensed or registered to do so under the laws of this state.</p>
          <p class="in">(b) No physical therapist licensed less than one year may treat human ailments, without referral, by physical therapy treatment without first having practiced one year in collaboration with a physical therapist with more than one year of experience or under a physician's orders or referrals as verified by the board's records.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.76.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1951/0/479/#laws.0.12.0">1951 c 479 s 12</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1980/0/412/#laws.0.10.0">1980 c 412 s 10</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1985/0/182/#laws.0.3.0">1985 c 182 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1986/0/444/#laws.0.0.0">1986 c 444</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1988/0/549/#laws.0.5.0">1988 c 549 s 5</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1991/0/106/#laws.0.6.0">1991 c 106 s 6</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1991/0/199/#laws.2.1.0">1991 c 199 art 2 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1998/0/317/#laws.0.10.0">1998 c 317 s 10</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/245/#laws.9.61.0">1999 c 245 art 9 s 61</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.34.0">2007 c 123 s 34</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2008/0/199/#laws.0.3.0">2008 c 199 s 3</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.77">
        <h1 class="shn">148.77 VIOLATIONS.</h1>
        <p>Any person violating the provisions of section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.76">148.76</a> is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.77.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1951/0/479/#laws.0.13.0">1951 c 479 s 13</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1980/0/412/#laws.0.12.0">1980 c 412 s 12</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.148.775"><b>148.775</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.137.0">2007 c 123 s 137</a>]</div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.78">
        <h1 class="shn">148.78 PROSECUTION, ALLEGATIONS.</h1>
        <p class="in">In the prosecution of any person for violation of sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.65">148.65</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.78">148.78</a> as specified in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.76">148.76</a>, it shall not be necessary to allege or prove want of a valid license as a physical therapist or physical therapist assistant, but shall be a matter of defense to be established by the accused.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.78.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1951/0/749/#laws.0.14.0">1951 c 749 s 14</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1980/0/412/#laws.0.13.0">1980 c 412 s 13</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/245/#laws.9.62.0">1999 c 245 art 9 s 62</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2007/0/123/#laws.0.35.0">2007 c 123 s 35</a></p>
      </div>
      <h1 class="fgh">ATHLETIC TRAINERS</h1>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.7801">
        <h1 class="shn">148.7801 CITATION.</h1>
        <p>Sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7801">148.7801</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7815">148.7815</a> may be cited as the "Minnesota Athletic Trainers Act."</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.7801.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first">
          <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/232/#laws.0.2.0">1993 c 232 s 2</a>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.7802">
        <h1 class="shn">148.7802 DEFINITIONS.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7802.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Applicability.</span></h2>
          <p>The definitions in this section apply to this chapter.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7802.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Approved continuing education program.</span></h2>
          <p>"Approved continuing education program" means a continuing education program that meets the maintenance of competence requirements in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7812">148.7812</a> and is approved by the board.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7802.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Approved education program.</span></h2>
          <p>"Approved education program" means an education program offered by an accredited university, college, or other postsecondary institution that, at the time the student completes the program, makes the student eligible to attain national certification as an athletic trainer from the Board of Certification for the Athletic Trainer or its recognized successor.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7802.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Athlete.</span></h2>
          <p>"Athlete" means a person participating in exercises, sports, games, or recreation requiring physical strength, agility, flexibility, range of motion, speed, or stamina.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7802.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.<span class="headnote">Athletic injury.</span></h2>
          <p>"Athletic injury" means an injury sustained by a person as a result of the person's participation in exercises, sports, games, or recreation requiring physical strength, agility, flexibility, range of motion, speed, or stamina.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7802.6">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 6.<span class="headnote">Athletic trainer.</span></h2>
          <p>"Athletic trainer" means a person who engages in athletic training under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7806">148.7806</a> and is licensed under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7808">148.7808</a>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7802.7">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 7.<span class="headnote">Board.</span></h2>
          <p>"Board" means the Board of Medical Practice.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7802.8">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 8.<span class="headnote">Credential.</span></h2>
          <p>"Credential" means a license, permit, certification, registration, or other evidence of qualification or authorization to practice as an athletic trainer in this state or any other state.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7802.9">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 9.<span class="headnote">Credentialing examination.</span></h2>
          <p>"Credentialing examination" means an examination administered by the Board of Certification for the Athletic Trainer or its recognized successor.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7802.10">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 10.<span class="headnote">Primary employment site.</span></h2>
          <p>"Primary employment site" means the institution, organization, corporation, or sports team where the athletic trainer is employed for the practice of athletic training.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7802.11">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 11.<span class="headnote">Primary physician.</span></h2>
          <p>"Primary physician" means a licensed medical physician who serves as a medical consultant to an athletic trainer.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.7802.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/232/#laws.0.3.0">1993 c 232 s 3</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/291/#laws.4.14.0">2014 c 291 art 4 s 14</a>,15; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2018/0/143/#laws.0.1.0">2018 c 143 s 1</a>-4; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2019/0/50/#laws.1.51.0">2019 c 50 art 1 s 51</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.7803">
        <h1 class="shn">148.7803 PROHIBITED PRACTICE OR USE OF TITLES; PENALTY.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7803.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">License required.</span></h2>
          <p>No person shall engage in athletic training without first being licensed under sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7801">148.7801</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7815">148.7815</a>. A person engages in athletic training if the person performs or offers to perform athletic training as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7806">148.7806</a>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7803.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Designation.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) A person shall not use in connection with the person's name or in any form of advertising, professional literature, or billing that relates to the person's occupation or profession as an athletic trainer, the words or letters registered athletic trainer; licensed athletic trainer; Minnesota registered athletic trainer; athletic trainer; AT; LAT; ATR; or any words, letters, abbreviations, or insignia indicating or implying that the person is an athletic trainer, without being licensed as an athletic trainer under sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7801">148.7801</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7815">148.7815</a>.</p>
          <p>(b) Any person who is exempt from licensure under subdivision 3 must not use any of the titles identified in paragraph (a), or any description stating or implying that they are engaged in the practice of athletic training or that they are licensed to engage in the practice of athletic training.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7803.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Exceptions.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) Nothing in sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7801">148.7801</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7815">148.7815</a> shall be construed to prohibit the practice of any profession or occupation licensed or registered by the state or to perform any act that falls within the scope of practice of the licensed or registered profession or occupation.</p>
          <p>(b) Nothing in sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7801">148.7801</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7815">148.7815</a> shall be construed to require an athletic trainer license for:</p>
          <p>(1) a student engaged in athletic training as part of an accredited athletic training program if the student is under the direct supervision of a licensed athletic trainer and is identified as an "athletic training student"; or</p>
          <p>(2) an athletic trainer as a member of the United States armed forces while performing duties incident to duty.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7803.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Penalty.</span></h2>
          <p>A person who violates this section is guilty of a misdemeanor and subject to section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/214.11">214.11</a>.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.7803.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/232/#laws.0.4.0">1993 c 232 s 4</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/291/#laws.4.16.0">2014 c 291 art 4 s 16</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2018/0/143/#laws.0.5.0">2018 c 143 s 5</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.7804">
        <h1 class="shn">148.7804 POWERS OF THE BOARD.</h1>
        <p>The board, acting under the advice of the Athletic Trainers Advisory Council, shall issue all licenses and shall exercise the following powers and duties:</p>
        <p>(1) adopt rules necessary to implement sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7801">148.7801</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7815">148.7815</a>;</p>
        <p>(2) prescribe license application forms, license forms, protocol forms, and other necessary forms;</p>
        <p>(3) approve a licensure examination;</p>
        <p>(4) keep a complete record of licensed athletic trainers, prepare a current official listing of the names and addresses of licensed athletic trainers, and make a copy of the list available to any person requesting it upon payment of a copying fee established by the board;</p>
        <p>(5) keep a permanent record of all its proceedings; and</p>
        <p>(6) establish the duties of, and employ, clerical personnel.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.7804.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/232/#laws.0.5.0">1993 c 232 s 5</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2018/0/143/#laws.0.6.0">2018 c 143 s 6</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.7805">
        <h1 class="shn">148.7805 ATHLETIC TRAINERS ADVISORY COUNCIL.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7805.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote"> Membership.</span></h2>
          <p>The Athletic Trainers Advisory Council is created and is composed of eight members appointed by the board. The advisory council consists of:</p>
          <p>(1) two public members as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/214.02">214.02</a>;</p>
          <p>(2) three members who are licensed athletic trainers, one being both a licensed physical therapist and licensed athletic trainer as submitted by the Minnesota American Physical Therapy Association;</p>
          <p>(3) two members who are medical physicians licensed by the state and have experience with athletic training and sports medicine; and</p>
          <p>(4) one member who is a doctor of chiropractic licensed by the state and has experience with athletic training and sports injuries.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7805.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Administration.</span></h2>
          <p>The advisory council is established and administered under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/15.059">15.059</a>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7805.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Duties.</span></h2>
          <p>The advisory council shall:</p>
          <p>(1) advise the board regarding standards for athletic trainers;</p>
          <p>(2) distribute information regarding athletic trainer standards;</p>
          <p>(3) advise the board on enforcement of sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7801">148.7801</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7815">148.7815</a>;</p>
          <p>(4) review license applications and license renewal applications and make recommendations to the board;</p>
          <p>(5) review complaints in accordance with sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/214.10">214.10</a> and <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/214.13#stat.214.13.6">214.13, subdivision 6</a>;</p>
          <p>(6) review investigation reports of complaints and recommend to the board whether disciplinary action should be taken;</p>
          <p>(7) advise the board regarding evaluation and treatment protocols;</p>
          <p>(8) advise the board regarding approval of continuing education programs; and</p>
          <p>(9) perform other duties authorized for advisory councils under chapter <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/214">214</a>, as directed by the board.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.7805.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/232/#laws.0.6.0">1993 c 232 s 6</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2000/0/260/#laws.0.25.0">2000 c 260 s 25</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/286/#laws.8.20.0">2014 c 286 art 8 s 20</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/291/#laws.4.17.0">2014 c 291 art 4 s 17</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2018/0/143/#laws.0.7.0">2018 c 143 s 7</a>,8</p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.7806">
        <h1 class="shn">148.7806 ATHLETIC TRAINING.</h1>
        <p>Athletic training by a licensed athletic trainer under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7808">148.7808</a> includes the activities described in paragraphs (a) to (e).</p>
        <p>(a) An athletic trainer shall:</p>
        <p>(1) prevent, recognize, and evaluate athletic injuries;</p>
        <p>(2) give emergency care and first aid;</p>
        <p>(3) manage and treat athletic injuries; and</p>
        <p>(4) rehabilitate and physically recondition athletic injuries.</p>
        <p>The athletic trainer may use modalities such as cold, heat, light, sound, electricity, exercise, and mechanical devices for treatment and rehabilitation of athletic injuries to athletes in the primary employment site.</p>
        <p>(b) The primary physician shall establish evaluation and treatment protocols to be used by the athletic trainer. The primary physician shall record the protocols on a form prescribed by the board. The protocol form must be updated yearly at the athletic trainer's license renewal time and kept on file by the athletic trainer.</p>
        <p>(c) At the primary employment site, except in a corporate setting, an athletic trainer may evaluate and treat an athlete for an athletic injury not previously diagnosed for not more than 30 days, or a period of time as designated by the primary physician on the protocol form, from the date of the initial evaluation and treatment. Preventative care after resolution of the injury is not considered treatment. This paragraph does not apply to a person who is referred for treatment by a person licensed in this state to practice medicine as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/147.081">147.081</a>, to practice chiropractic as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.01">148.01</a>, to practice podiatry as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/153.01">153.01</a>, or to practice dentistry as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/150A.05">150A.05</a> and whose license is in good standing.</p>
        <p>(d) An athletic trainer may:</p>
        <p>(1) organize and administer an athletic training program including, but not limited to, educating and counseling athletes;</p>
        <p>(2) monitor the signs, symptoms, general behavior, and general physical response of an athlete to treatment and rehabilitation including, but not limited to, whether the signs, symptoms, reactions, behavior, or general response show abnormal characteristics; and</p>
        <p>(3) make suggestions to the primary physician or other treating provider for a modification in the treatment and rehabilitation of an injured athlete based on the indicators in clause (2).</p>
        <p>(e) In a clinical, corporate, and physical therapy setting, when the service provided is, or is represented as being, physical therapy, an athletic trainer may work only under the direct supervision of a physical therapist as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.65">148.65</a>.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.7806.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/232/#laws.0.7.0">1993 c 232 s 7</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2018/0/143/#laws.0.9.0">2018 c 143 s 9</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.7807">
        <h1 class="shn">148.7807 LIMITATIONS ON PRACTICE.</h1>
        <p>If an athletic trainer determines that a patient's medical condition is beyond the scope of practice of that athletic trainer, the athletic trainer must refer the patient to a person licensed in this state to practice medicine as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/147.081">147.081</a>, to practice chiropractic as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.01">148.01</a>, to practice podiatry as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/153.01">153.01</a>, or to practice dentistry as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/150A.05">150A.05</a> and whose license is in good standing and in accordance with established evaluation and treatment protocols. An athletic trainer shall modify or terminate treatment of a patient that is not beneficial to the patient, or that is not tolerated by the patient.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.7807.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first">
          <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/232/#laws.0.8.0">1993 c 232 s 8</a>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.7808">
        <h1 class="shn">148.7808 LICENSURE; REQUIREMENTS.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7808.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Licensure.</span></h2>
          <p>The board may issue an athletic trainer license to applicants who meet the requirements under this section. An applicant for licensure as an athletic trainer shall:</p>
          <p>(1) pay a fee under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7815">148.7815</a>;</p>
          <p>(2) file a written application on a form, provided by the board, that includes:</p>
          <p>(i) the applicant's name, Social Security number, home address and telephone number, business address and telephone number, and business setting;</p>
          <p>(ii) evidence satisfactory to the board of current national credentialing as a certified athletic trainer by the Board of Certification for the Athletic Trainer or its recognized successor;</p>
          <p>(iii) educational background;</p>
          <p>(iv) credentials held in this state or in other jurisdictions;</p>
          <p>(v) a description of any jurisdiction's refusal to credential the applicant;</p>
          <p>(vi) a description of all professional disciplinary actions initiated against the applicant in any jurisdiction;</p>
          <p>(vii) any history of drug or alcohol abuse, and any misdemeanor or felony conviction;</p>
          <p>(viii) additional information as requested by the board;</p>
          <p>(ix) the applicant's signature on a statement that the information in the application is true and correct to the best of the applicant's knowledge and belief; and</p>
          <p>(x) the applicant's signature on a waiver authorizing the board to obtain access to the applicant's records in this state or any other state in which the applicant has completed an education program approved by the board, engaged in the practice of athletic training, or held other professional credentials;</p>
          <p>(3) if the applicant holds or has held a credential as an athletic trainer in another jurisdiction, provide verification from the credentialing body in each jurisdiction that the applicant holds or has held a credential for the practice of athletic training; and</p>
          <p>(4) if the applicant holds or has held a credential as another health professional in this state or another jurisdiction, provide verification from the credentialing body for that profession that the applicant holds or has held a credential for the practice of that profession.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7808.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.</h2>
          <p>[Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/291/#laws.4.59.0">2014 c 291 art 4 s 59</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7808.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.</h2>
          <p>MS 2016 [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2018/0/143/#laws.0.26.0">2018 c 143 s 26</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7808.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.</h2>
          <p>MS 2016 [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2018/0/143/#laws.0.26.0">2018 c 143 s 26</a>]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7808.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.</h2>
          <p>MS 2016 [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2018/0/143/#laws.0.26.0">2018 c 143 s 26</a>]</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.7808.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/232/#laws.0.9.0">1993 c 232 s 9</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1999/0/33/#laws.0.7.0">1999 c 33 s 7</a>,8; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/291/#laws.4.18.0">2014 c 291 art 4 s 18</a>,19; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2018/0/143/#laws.0.10.0">2018 c 143 s 10</a>,25</p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.7809">
        <h1 class="shn">148.7809 LICENSE RENEWAL.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7809.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Requirements for license renewal.</span></h2>
          <p> An athletic trainer license issued under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7808">148.7808</a> expires annually. To renew a license, an athletic trainer shall pay a fee as required by section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7815">148.7815</a> and complete a renewal application on a form provided by the board that includes:</p>
          <p>(1) the athletic trainer's name, Minnesota athletic trainer license number, home address and telephone number, business address and telephone number, and business setting;</p>
          <p>(2) work history for the past year, including the average number of hours worked per week;</p>
          <p>(3) a report of any change in status since initial licensure or previous license renewal;</p>
          <p>(4) evidence satisfactory to the board of having met the continuing education requirements of section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7812">148.7812</a>;</p>
          <p>(5) the athletic trainer's signature on a statement that a current copy of the protocol form is on file at the athletic trainer's primary employment site;</p>
          <p>(6) any history of drug or alcohol abuse, and any misdemeanor or felony conviction; and</p>
          <p>(7) any disciplinary action on any credential held in this state or in another jurisdiction.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7809.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">License renewal notice.</span></h2>
          <p> The board shall annually send out a renewal notice to an athletic trainer's last known address on file with the board. The notice shall include an application for license renewal and notice of the fees required for renewal. An athletic trainer who does not receive a renewal notice must still meet the requirements for license renewal under this section.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7809.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Renewal deadline.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) An application for renewal of licensure must be postmarked on or before July 1 of each year. If the postmark is illegible, the application is considered timely if received in the board office by the third working day after July 1.</p>
          <p>(b) An application for renewal of licensure submitted after the deadline date must include a late fee under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7815">148.7815</a>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7809.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Licensure following lapse of licensed status for two years or less.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) In order to regain licensed status, an athletic trainer whose license has lapsed for two years or less must:</p>
          <p>(1) apply for license renewal under subdivision 1;</p>
          <p>(2) document compliance with the continuing education requirements in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7812">148.7812 </a>since the athletic trainer's initial licensure or last renewal; and</p>
          <p>(3) submit the fees required by section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7815">148.7815</a> for the period the athletic trainer was not licensed, including the fee for late renewal.</p>
          <p>(b) The board shall not renew, reissue, reinstate, or restore a license that has lapsed after June 30, 1999, and has not been renewed within two annual renewal cycles starting July 1, 2001. An athletic trainer whose license is canceled for nonrenewal must obtain a new license by applying for licensure and fulfilling all requirements then in existence for an initial license.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.148.7809.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1993/0/232/#laws.0.10.0">1993 c 232 s 10</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2001/0/31/#laws.0.2.0">2001 c 31 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2018/0/143/#laws.0.11.0">2018 c 143 s 11</a>-13,25</p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.148.7810">
        <h1 class="shn">148.7810 BOARD ACTION ON APPLICATIONS.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7810.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Verification of application information.</span></h2>
          <p>The board or advisory council, with the approval of the board, may verify information provided by an applicant for licensure under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7808">148.7808</a> and license renewal under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/148.7809">148.7809</a> to determine whether the information is accurate and complete.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7810.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Notification of board action.</span></h2>
          <p>Within 120 days of receipt of the application, the board shall notify each applicant in writing of the action taken on the application.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.148.7810.3">
